'''Stalsinek IV''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. It was the site of the [[Temple of Stalsinek]], which in turn contained a fountain that was the source of legendary healing [[Water/Legends|waters]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], two groups of offworlders visited Stalsinek IV in order to acquire a sample of the healing waters, with one of the groups coming into contact with a local tribe of beings that worshiped at the temple.

==Description==
Stalsinek IV was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="Stalsinek" /> in the [[Stalsinek system/Legends|Stalsinek system]]. It was located in the [[Corsair Outback]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Stalsinek IV lay on the [[Great Rim Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that linked it to the [[Jodaka system/Legends|Jodaka]] and [[Nantuker system/Legends|Nantuker systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Stalsinek IV's surface featured harsh, dangerous [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="Stalsinek" />

==History==
{{RPG|"[[Temple of Stalsinek]]"}}
At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jorkatt]] offered a large sum of [[Currency/Legends|money]] to anyone who would bring him the legendary healing [[Water/Legends|waters]] from the fountain located at the [[Temple of Stalsinek]] on Stalsinek IV. Subsequently, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] traveled there in order to acquire an amount of the healing waters, in the process making contact with a tribe of beings who lived in the planet's jungle and worshiped at the temple. At the same time, another group of adventurers also visited the world, willing to despoil it in order to obtain the waters. Both groups eventually came into conflict at the temple.<ref name="Stalsinek" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
The jungle of Stalsinek IV was home to a tribe of beings who worshipped at the Temple of Stalsinek.<ref name="Stalsinek" />

==Locations==
Stalsinek IV was the site of the ancient Temple of Stalsinek, which was hidden in the planet's jungle. It contained a fountain, the waters of which had healing properties that eventually made them and the temple the subject of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] legends.<ref name="Stalsinek" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stalsinek IV was created by [[Bill Olmesdahl]] as the setting for "[[Temple of Stalsinek (adventure hook)|Temple of Stalsinek]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure hook published in the [[1992]] supplement ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Stalsinek" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Stalsinek [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Stalsinek IV, in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
